questions.question: Is the area free of trash, materials, and other debris on the ground?
Are there enough trash cans around the area?
Are the trash cans emptied often enough that they don't pile up or spill?
Are walking and working areas clear of slip and trip hazards like trash, standing water, ice, or mud?
Are laydown areas set up and marked?
Are materials stored properly: on dunnage, steel on 6x6 dunnage, and pipe and rolling stock chocked?
Is there a fire extinguisher near each laydown area?
Is a traffic plan in place?
Are walk paths marked and separated from traffic?
Are roadways clear and in good shape?
Is the lighting adequate?
Are spotters in use?
Is any work happening in active roadways?

follow_up.Yes: How is the traffic control plan being followed?

questions.question: Is there a clear emergency access path?
Is anyone working 6 feet or more above a lower level, including in aerial lifts?

follow_up.Yes: What type of work, and where?

questions.question: Are elevation changes of 19 inches or more protected with a ramp, stairs, warning line, or other means?
Are all open holes 2 inches or larger covered, secured, and signed?
Are guard rails and cables set up properly: top rail at 42 inches plus or minus 3, mid rail, toe board, 200 pound rating, and 3 cable clamps?
Are any scaffolds in use, with signed inspection tags and used properly?
Are aerial lifts in use by people with training on file?

follow_up.Yes: About how many aerial lifts are on site?

questions.question: Are all aerial lifts inspected before use each day?
Is anyone using personal fall arrest gear, and is it inspected and fitted properly?
Is the fall protection equipment right for the situation, like the lanyard type and edge protection?
Is there active ground disturbance on site?
Is the site utility map posted?
Are ground disturbance permits in place for all operations?
Are spoils at least 4 feet back from the edge?
Is there access and egress within 25 feet of workers?
Are excavation walls protected by sloping, shoring, or a trench box?
Is tabulated data on site for the protective systems?
Do excavations 6 feet or deeper have fall protection?
Is there snow fence or a hard barricade around excavations when they're unattended?
Are any cranes in use?

follow_up.Yes: How many, what are they doing, and where?

questions.question: Are all crane inspections up to date?
Does each crane have a controlled access zone for the swing radius and load?
Is all other equipment inspected each day and free of leaks or damage?
Do operators have training certificates on file and stickers on their helmets?
Are operators of mobile equipment wearing seatbelts?
Does all mobile equipment have working backup alarms, horns, lights, mirrors, and signals?
Does all mobile equipment have a fire extinguisher the operator can reach?
Are aerial lifts used on firm, level ground with crush protection over the controls?
